decisions.reason: The coolant pressure booster is integral to the firm's core coolant management offer and its announced direction, so the investment and public commitment keep it in the portfolio and any weak results are read as temporary.

The cleaning centrifuge supports the firm's publicly stated sustainability and filtration focus, so management would justify continued investment and attribute any slow uptake to the current weak machine-tool market.
The nozzle line is a low-cost, visible complement to the coolant systems, so management would prune individual models rather than withdraw the line.
Scraper belt chip conveyors are a staple of the established conveying business, and dropping them would undercut the firm's core identity and its earlier investment.

The magnetic belt conveyor builds directly on the firm's chip conveyor range for metalworking customers, and after the hinged belt withdrawal management wants to show its remaining conveyor lineup is the right choice.
